scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF peer issue signals for LTYPE text, FIELD lifecycle, EED/XDATA alignment, repeated DXF input, locale-sensitive codepages, and binary proxy output; map only verified evidence to existing plan owners.

method.kind: Read-only web research and local plan/test-inventory reconciliation
method.evidenceRule: Issue-index titles are discovery leads. The unavailable LibreDWG #1450–#1452 bodies do not establish full reproducers, root causes, fix status, or normative behavior. Accessible peer reports are scoped to their reported versions/routes and cannot be transferred to libdxfrw without local reproduction and primary-source reconciliation.

observed: #1450's index title reports a heap-buffer-overflow in add_LTYPE_dashes for R2007+ DXF linetypes with dash text.
#1451's index title reports a use-after-free in add_FIELD for a FIELD with zero child values (93=0).
#1452's index title reports a UBSan misaligned BITCODE_RS load in dwg_encode_eed_data for an R2007+ DXF/XDATA string.
The issue pages could not be retrieved during this pass; source revision, reproducers, stack traces, exact root causes, and current fix status remain unverified.
LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS records separate bounds, cursor-progress, allocation, and stale-container-pointer fixes; these remain peer implementation findings.
doesNotEstablish: A normative LTYPE, FIELD, EED, or XDATA rule
A regression boundary, sample, or root cause suitable for copying into local code
evidence.planUse: Use only as conditional prompts under existing PAR-14/PAR-26, 7BF, 7S/7G, and FIELD fail-closed owners. If those local paths change, author generated tests from ODA and local source rather than peer offsets or titles.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp repeated-record, codepage, and compound-vertex reports
observed: #1281 describes recursive advancement for runs of comments, XDATA application blocks, and IMAGE/WIPEOUT clipping groups, with process-crash reports for long inputs.
#1280 describes current-culture lowercasing of ANSI_1254 failing under Turkish/Azeri culture settings.
#1279 describes an AC1014 POLYLINE/VERTEX record without a more-specific AcDb2dVertex subclass marker leaving a placeholder that crashes the ACadSharp document builder.
doesNotEstablish: That the peer route or version matches the libdxfrw route
A required tolerant recovery policy without Autodesk/ODA or producer evidence
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing local repeated-record hardening, CP1254/CP949 end-to-end controls, and compound-record isolation. Keep parent-based child typing gated on normative/source evidence.

evidence.topic: Title-only ACadSharp #1282/#1283 and ezdxf proxy writer status
observed: ACadSharp's live issue index titles #1282 as per-application EED size overflow/loss and #1283 as deep nested-block copy cost/stack risk; their bodies were not retrieved in this pass.
ezdxf #1412's ASCII-versus-binary proxy-graphic writer failure and merged #1418 fix are already documented in 7AP/PAR-76; this research found no new local gap.
doesNotEstablish: An EED wire-size limit from the peer title
A local nested-block recursion or copy defect
A current unresolved ezdxf binary-proxy writer defect
evidence.planUse: Keep #1282/#1283 as discovery leads under existing EED and graph/resource owners; do not copy limits. Reuse the existing local binary proxy matrix and exact ezdxf pin rule.
